title: berth deploy payload (v1)
description: The HMAC-signed JSON body a vessel POSTs to the berth runner. Owned by jlopez/berth-action; vendor a pinned copy host-side and validate inbound payloads against it before acting.

v.description: Contract version. Fixed by berth-notify; a future shape bumps this so the runner can branch on it. Unknown future keys are allowed (additionalProperties), so adding fields stays backward-compatible.

repo.description: owner/name, exactly one slash. The runner still matches this against its allowlist — this only gates shape.

ref.description: Commit SHA to check out deploy/compose.yml from.

instance.description: main, staging (a continuous-deploy environment re-pointed via berth-notify's overridable instance input), or pr-<n> for a preview.

host_base.description: DNS-safe Caddy hostname base, no trailing dash (e.g. gubs or gubs-pr-8). A root service routes to ${HOST_BASE}.jesusla.com; a suffixed one joins it with a dash (${HOST_BASE}-sim.jesusla.com). Flows into hostnames, so it is a single lowercase DNS label.

tag.description: Image tag the vessel CI pushed: main, pr-<n>, or an immutable release tag v<X.Y.Z> (a version-picked production deploy). Note a staging instance still deploys the main image tag — instance and tag diverge by design there.

action.description: up to deploy, down to tear down. (skip never reaches the runner.)

deploy_id.description: Optional per-CI-run correlation token (e.g. run_id-run_attempt). The runner keys its deploy-status file on it so the vessel can poll /hooks/berth-status until the stack docks. Filename-safe charset, no '/'. Additive and backward-compatible (not in `required`): a runner that ignores it still deploys; berth-notify always sends it.

secrets.description: KEY=value pairs written host-side to the stack env file; may be empty ({}). Keys start with a letter or underscore and may contain letters, digits, underscores, and dots — dots allow dotted property names some apps read from the environment (e.g. ArcadeDB's `arcadedb.server.rootPassword`). The `=`/whitespace/newline exclusion keeps the line-oriented env file from being corrupted or injected into.
